description: List playbooks with optional status filter. Returns playbook metadata including IDs, titles, and lifecycle status.
embedding_description: List available playbooks and their metadata, optionally filtered by lifecycle status. Use to inspect active, draft, or completed playbooks; discover candidate playbook_ids before retrieval or patching; review titles and timestamps; and understand which phased execution guides already exist for a project or workspace.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: List of playbook objects with metadata
